name: garage-ui-unit-harness
description: QC-owned Vitest+RTL harness for garage-web UI unit/structural (C1) checks. Reuses garage-function/gf-gms-web installed node_modules (react/react-dom/@apollo/client/@radix-ui/*) via resolve.alias to avoid duplicate-React instance hazard and avoid re-installing the full frontend dependency tree. Read-only reference to the frontend repo — never writes into it.
